senses.gloss: m. (horreum, pl. horrea, ὡρεῖον, ὥριον; v. Sm. Ant. s. v.) store-house, store (of all kinds). Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Genesis 7">B’resh. 7</cite> <he>וכל א׳ שלי בתוכה</he> all my stores are in that ship.—Pl. <he>אוּרְיָאַיָּא</he> (ch. form).
